svg.title: Altered level of consciousness: treat the reversible causes first, then the exam (brainstem reflexes, each with its in and out pathway, breathing, motor response, eye opening and signs of awareness, scored in coma by the GCS or FOUR score) places the patient as brain death, coma, vegetative state, minimally conscious state minus or plus, or a locked-in coma mimic

Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Not responding: FIRST look for the TREATABLE causes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: shock or low blood pressure · low glucose · diabetic ketoacidosis · hypertensive encephalopathy · drug intoxication

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: bacterial or fungal meningitis · herpes simplex encephalitis · brain abscess · epidural or subdural hematoma

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: also consider: syncope · seizure, post-ictal state · encephalopathy, delirium

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: then EXAMINE: is the patient AWAKE (alertness = VOLUME) and AWARE (awareness = TUNING, the cortex)?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: alertness: ascending reticular activating system, upper pons + midbrain → thalamus, hypothalamus → cortex

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: brainstem reflexes and eye opening decide

svg.text: • pupil: II → III (Edinger-Westphal) · blown pupil = uncal herniation

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Horner: ptosis, miosis ± anhidrosis · 3-neuron sympathetic path

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • doll's eyes (no C-spine concern) + calorics: VIII → III, IV, VI

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • calorics in COMA: only SLOW deviation toward cold · COWS is the awake fast phase

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • corneal: V → VII · gag: IX → X · cough: often the LAST lost
